issues.text: О25 named the base as tools/src/handoffs/exceptions.tsv; its correction line (and `find tools -name exceptions.tsv`) gives tools/handoffs/exceptions.tsv, which the block uses.

Remaining ways to defeat criterion 8 that I see (О27). Both pass the mechanical parts of (a), (b) and (c), and both also pass the tag's code-form greps; only RELEASE-VALIDATOR's reading in (b) refuses them («reached on every run, not inside a condition on the content or the order of the base, and over every record»). (1) X2: the four checks run only when the probes' own change is present (here: the first record is not R1), so a real base that keeps R1 and holds a forbidden row passes. Any finite set of probes can be special-cased this way (the dropped record, its place, the count), so this class is closed by reading, not by more probes. (2) X3: a `has` blind to one place that neither probe uses (index 50). The real base is sorted and the rows' sorted places are probed, so a row placed there would have to be out of sort order. Probing every place (110 × 4 runs, about a minute) would close X3 mechanically; I did not add it, because О25 names the top and the sorted place.

Strong forms refused by О25's rules: X4, a snapshot deepEqual of the 110 records, refuses the four rows but names none of the four paths and prints the whole base on failure, so (b) and (c) refuse it. W12 (an order pin with the four !has) is refused by the top placement. Both refusals follow О25's own words.

Why (c) holds «the path of no other record of E but R1's»: without it, X1 (no !has, an H4 count that dumps all records on failure, the four paths named in a comment) passes (b)'s greps and the path and rule checks; with it, X1 is refused (62 other paths named). R1's path is allowed because the probes drop R1, and a correct diff-style message may name it.

My own trial artefact: my emulated pre_state record is a bare JSON in handoffs/ of a trial copy, so HC-7a and handoffs-check fail on that copy (S5). The criterion runs were made on copies without it where the full test file was needed.
